tokoh_utama: A 23-year-old Indonesian woman with shoulder-length black hair, wearing a dark green hoodie and jeans.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau kamu jadi aku, kamu bakal lapor polisi atau balas DM akun itu?
part.caption: Makin hari foto yang diunggah akun misterius ini makin dekat... Sampai tadi jam 2 pagi. #ceritahoror #misteri

adegan.narasi: Ada akun Instagram tanpa nama yang mendadak posting foto-foto diriku dari belakang.
adegan.gambar: A glowing smartphone screen displaying an anonymous Instagram profile feed showing candid pictures of a young woman taken from behind.

adegan.narasi: Foto pertama diambil dari seberang jalan kantor, pas aku nunggu jemputan ojek online.
adegan.gambar: POV from across a busy street looking at the main character standing on the sidewalk at dusk waiting for her ride.

adegan.narasi: Foto kedua diposting besok malamnya, diambil dari sudut parkiran motor yang sangat sepi.
adegan.gambar: Dim underground basement parking lot. On the wet concrete floor, a dirty water puddle clearly reflects a tall, unnaturally thin pale figure holding up a smartphone, pointing at the main character.

adegan.narasi: Aku mulai merasa risih dan ketakutan, lalu memutuskan buru-buru pulang ke rumah kos.
adegan.gambar: Main character walking rapidly down a quiet, dimly lit narrow alley looking back over her shoulder with an anxious expression.

adegan.narasi: Sesampainya di gerbang kosan, aku langsung masuk dan mengunci pagar tinggi-tinggi.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the main character hastily locking a tall black iron gate of a boarding house at night.

adegan.narasi: Saat aku sedang menyeduh mie instan di kamar, ponselku mendadak bergetar kencang.
adegan.gambar: A cozy small bedroom desk with a steaming cup of instant noodles beside a smartphone glowing brightly.

adegan.narasi: Foto ketiga diunggah, memperlihatkan diriku yang baru saja membuka pintu gerbang kosan.
adegan.gambar: Smartphone screen showing a dark photo of the main character unlocking the iron gate from a close street perspective.

adegan.narasi: Akun misterius ini tanpa nama, tanpa followers, dan hanya mengikuti akun pribadiku saja.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of Instagram account profile page showing no profile picture, 0 followers, 0 posts, and following only 1 account.

adegan.narasi: Karena makin panik, aku mengunci pintu kamar rapat-rapat dan memasang gerendel tambahan.
adegan.gambar: Main character locking her wooden bedroom door from inside and sliding a heavy metal latch locked tight.

adegan.narasi: Tepat jam dua pagi, ponselku kembali bergetar menandakan ada unggahan foto terbaru.
adegan.gambar: Dark bedroom lit only by the glowing blue screen of a smartphone buzzing violently on the bed sheet at 02:00 AM.

adegan.narasi: Foto keempat diambil dari lorong kosan gelap, tepat berada di depan pintu kamarku!
adegan.gambar: Terrifying photo displayed on smartphone screen showing the main character's bedroom wooden door from the dark hallway outside.

part.pertanyaan: Ada yang sadar sosok di pantulan genangan? Ngaku di komen.
part.caption: Aku kira nginep di rumah temen bakal aman. Ternyata foto baru ini bikin makin merinding... #ceritahoror #part2

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan. Tanpa pikir panjang, paginya aku packing dan kabur menginap di rumah temanku.
adegan.gambar: Main character hastily packing clothes into a duffel bag inside her bedroom under bright morning sunlight.

adegan.narasi: Siska menyambutku hangat dan berkata, "Tenang aja, di rumahku kamu pasti aman kok."
adegan.gambar: A friendly female friend welcoming the main character warmly at the front door of a suburban house.

adegan.narasi: Hari pertama di rumah Siska berlalu tenang tanpa ada notifikasi foto baru.
adegan.gambar: Main character sitting relaxed on a living room couch drinking tea next to her friend during daytime.

adegan.narasi: Memasuki hari kedua situasi masih sangat aman, membuat hatiku merasa agak lega.
adegan.gambar: Main character smiling softly while looking at her quiet phone screen sitting near a sunlit window.

adegan.narasi: Malam harinya kami menonton televisi bersama di ruang tamu sampai larut malam.
adegan.gambar: Living room late at night with TV screen casting dim blue light on main character and her friend sitting together.

adegan.narasi: Sekitar jam sebelas malam, aku pamit tidur di kamar tamu lantai bawah.
adegan.gambar: Main character walking into a cozy guest bedroom on the ground floor carrying a pillow.

adegan.narasi: Kipas angin tua berputar pelan, disertai lampu kamar teras yang mendadak kedap-kedip.
adegan.gambar: Guest bedroom interior with an old standing fan. In the shadow behind the bedroom window glass, two faint glowing eyes and a sinister silhouette silently watch inside.

adegan.narasi: Baru sebentar memejamkan mata, ponsel di sebelah bantal mendadak bergetar sangat kuat.
adegan.gambar: Main character opening her eyes suddenly in dark bedroom as her phone screen flashes brightly on the mattress.

adegan.narasi: Sebuah notifikasi Instagram muncul, akun misterius itu menandai namaku di postingan baru.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of smartphone screen displaying an Instagram notification pop-up stating 'You were tagged in a photo'.

adegan.narasi: Dengan jari gemetaran dan jantung berdebar kencang, aku memberanikan diri membuka fotonya.
adegan.gambar: Trembling hands of the main character holding the illuminated smartphone in the pitch black bedroom.

adegan.narasi: Foto terbaru memperlihatkan aku sedang tertidur di kasur, diambil tepat dari atas plafon!
adegan.gambar: Shocking photo on smartphone screen depicting an overhead high-angle view of the main character lying asleep on her bed inside this exact room.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau HP berdering di kolong kasurmu, kamu bakal kabur atau intip?
part.caption: Jangan pernah buka postingan terakhir... Sosok di pantulan kaca itu ternyata ada di dekatku. #ceritahoror #tamat

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan. Aku mendadak melompat dari kasur dengan napas memburu dan rasa takut luar biasa.
adegan.gambar: Main character jumping off her bed in utter panic, standing in the middle of the dark room breathing heavily.

adegan.narasi: Dengan tangan gemetar, aku mencoba memperbesar foto-foto lama dari akun teror tersebut.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of main character pinch-zooming into older photo uploads on her smartphone screen.

adegan.narasi: Saat aku perbesar foto di parkiran, ada detail mengerikan di genangan air bawah motor.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of smartphone screen zooming into a dirty puddle reflection showing a blurred silhouette holding a phone.

adegan.narasi: Di genangan itu terpantul sosok pria sangat kurus, tinggi ganjil, sedang memegang ponsel.
adegan.gambar: High contrast view of the reflection showing a scary, unnaturally elongated pale humanoid creature holding a smartphone.

adegan.narasi: Belum sempat aku memanggil Siska, ponselku kembali memunculkan notifikasi postingan foto terbaru.
adegan.gambar: Main character frozen in fear as a new post push notification flashes across her screen.

adegan.narasi: Aku menyentuh layar ponsel, melihat foto yang baru saja diunggah beberapa detik lalu.
adegan.gambar: Main character tapping the screen while staring with wide terrified eyes.

adegan.narasi: Foto itu menampilkan sudut pandang dari bawah dipan kasur, melihat ke arah kakiku.
adegan.gambar: Screen showing a dark low-angle perspective shot from under a bed wooden frame looking up at feet. In the dark gap under the bed frame, long pale bony fingers stretch out touching the floor tiles.

adegan.narasi: Di layar terlihat sepasang kakiku berdiri di samping tempat tidur dengan latar gelap.
adegan.gambar: Photo on phone showing main character's legs in dark green pants and bare feet standing near the bed edge.

adegan.narasi: Caption foto terbaru itu tertulis singkat dan sangat jelas: 'Jangan noleh ke bawah.'
adegan.gambar: Close-up of text caption on Instagram reading 'Jangan noleh ke bawah.' in stark white text.

adegan.narasi: Seluruh tubuhku langsung kaku seketika, udara terasa membeku di dalam kamar ini.
adegan.gambar: Main character standing paralyzed in middle of room staring down with horror in absolute dark atmosphere.

adegan.narasi: Detik berikutnya, suara dering panggilan ponsel mendadak nyaring terdengar dari kolong kasur.
adegan.gambar: Scary close-up shot of the pitch black gap underneath the bed frame as a muffled phone ringtone originates from deep beneath.
